title: Water Shutoff — North Area — Jul 6
_full_body: If you would like to respond to this notification, please place your response above the dotted line. Dear Residents, Please be advised that potable water service will be temporarily shut off in the North section of the community on July 8, 2026, at 9:00am to 11:00am for approximately 2 hours. This shut off is being completed at the request of a resident, with approval from park management, to address necessary maintenance. When water service is restored, please run water through your bathtub faucet or another spigot without a filter for several minutes to clear any air or sediment from the lines. We appreciate your cooperation and understanding. If you have any questions, please contact the park office. Sincerely, Park Management Sincerely, Resource Property Management, Inc. on behalf of Home Owners of Palm Hill, Inc (727) 581-2662 | www.resourcepropertymgmt.com
